commentary.text: 90+7' That's the end of the match.
90+5' A superb shot by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) after a mid-range free kick! His attempt, however, flies just over the crossbar.
90+3' Jeremy Stinat shows a yellow card to Lamine Camara (Metz) for his blatant foul.
90+2' Leo Leroy (Montpellier) controls a nice low pass and shoots from just outside the box, but it's a poor effort that flies into the stands. Wasted opportunity!
90+1' Arthur Atta (Metz) passes the ball into the box but an opposing player clears.
90' We will have 5 min. of added time.
89' Michel Der Zakarian prepares a substitution. Teji Savanier is replaced by Khalil Fayad (Montpellier).
89' The substitution is prepared. Tanguy Coulibaly (Montpellier) joins the action as a substitute, replacing Mousa Al-Tamari.
88' Referee Jeremy Stinat halts the game and wanders over to the touchline to talk to Laszlo Boloni, then shows him a yellow.
86' 3 - 0 Goal! Teji Savanier (Montpellier) wins the battle of wills and sends an unstoppable penalty past Alexandre Oukidja into left side of the goal.
85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is going to take the penalty!
85' Handball! A player from Metz handled the ball. The referee makes a call and blows his whistle for an infringement. Montpellier are awarded a penalty.
85' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) tries to bend in the free kick from the edge of the box, but the defensive wall makes an easy block.
83' It must be a yellow card. It is. Fali Cande (Metz) receives the caution after an awful tackle.
83' Arthur Atta (Metz) picks up a pass and unleashes a strong shot from inside the box, but the goalkeeper is equal to it!
82' Metz decide to take a short pass from the free kick and the attacking effort continues.
79' Michel Der Zakarian has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Akor Adams (Montpellier) replacing Arnaud Nordin.
79' Substitution. Jordan Ferri makes way for Leo Leroy (Montpellier).
78' Joel Asoro (Metz) is shown a yellow card after a horrible tackle.

78' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) is the first to arrive to a rebound inside the penalty area and unleashes a quick low strike towards the middle of the goal that beats the keeper. One of the defenders, however, makes a superb goal-line clearance.
76' Laszlo Boloni has decided to make a change. Cheikh Sabaly (Metz) replaces Didier Lamkel Ze.
75' A substitution has been made. Becir Omeragic goes off and Falaye Sacko (Montpellier) comes on.
73' Benjamin Lecomte comes off his line to intercept the corner from Arthur Atta (Metz).
72' The corner is swung in but Metz can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

71' Great solo effort by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) as he beats two defenders before firing in a drive from just outside of the box towards the bottom right corner. The goalkeeper is ready and makes an amazing save.
69' Becir Omeragic (Montpellier) has tested the patience of referee Jeremy Stinat and goes into the book for a previous late challenge.
68' The referee stops play so that a substitution can be made and Kevin Van Den Kerkhof trots off the pitch and is replaced by Joel Asoro (Metz).

67' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) attempts to find some of his teammates with a dangerous pass from the edge of the box. The opponent's defence, however, intercepts the effort and clears the ball to safety.
63' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Arthur Atta (Metz) is coming onto the pitch as Joseph Nduquidi cannot continue after picking up an injury.
63' Laszlo Boloni has decided to substitute Ismael Traore and he is replaced by Fali Cande (Metz).
62' Matthieu Udol (Metz) meets a cross and produces a header towards the right side of the goal, but one of the defending players blocks the effort.
60' A mid-range free kick is awarded to Metz out wide and from this angle a cross into the box is likely.
59' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) goes on a solo run, but he fails to create a chance as an opposition player blocks him.
58' Kevin Van Den Kerkhof (Metz) releases a low pass from just outside the box in an attempt to find his teammate, but one of the defenders calmly averts the threat.
55' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
55' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away.
54' The ball possession at the moment is 60:40.
53' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) gathers a nice lofted pass deep inside the box and attempts to put the ball low inside the left post, but his shot is deflected away by one of the defending players.
52' Matthieu Udol (Metz) finds space inside the box but rifles his effort miles past the right post.
50' 2 - 0 Goal! The corner is whipped in and Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) is in the right place at the right time, planting his header straight under the crossbar. He makes it 2:0.
50' The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Montpellier.
49' The corner from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is intercepted by the defence.
49' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) tries to find Issiaga Sylla with a clever through ball from the corner of the box, but the defence is alert to the danger and makes a clearance.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+4' Jeremy Stinat has ended the first half by blowing the whistle.
45+3' The free kick from long range, taken by Montpellier, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
45' 3 additional min. will be played.
45' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) meets an excellent cross and from the edge of the penalty box unleashes a fantastic header towards the bottom right corner of the goal, but it's blocked by a defender.
44' The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Metz.
43' What a great touch by Georges Mikautadze (Metz) as he controls a fine pass into the box and takes a shot to the right side of the goal, but an opposing player makes a clearance. Great defending.

42' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) receives a low pass just outside the box and unleashes a fine strike towards the bottom right corner. Alexandre Oukidja pulls off a reflexive save to block his effort. Nice goalkeeping skill, indeed.
41' Sadibou Sane (Metz) performs a sliding tackle but catches his opponent's legs. The referee blows his whistle for an infringement.

40' Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) didn't manage to convert the resulting corner kick into a goal. He produced a header from a dangerous position inside the box, but his attempt went well wide of the right post.
39' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) looks like he will be the one to try and deliver a quality ball into the penalty box from the corner kick.
39' Montpellier are ruled offside.

37' Joris Chotard (Montpellier) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads towards the bottom left corner, but Alexandre Oukidja shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
35' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) once again attempts to send a defence-splitting pass, but the opposition's defence is alert and intercepts the ball.
33' Joseph Nduquidi (Metz) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away.
31' The referee points to the corner flag and Metz will take a corner.
30' Modibo Sagnan (Montpellier) is booked after bringing down an opponent. Jeremy Stinat had an easy-decision to make.
28' Chance! Georges Mikautadze (Metz) comes within inches of scoring after picking up a pass from Kevin Van Den Kerkhof, but his shot from inside the box flashes inches wide of the right post.
26' A dangerous looking corner kick from Teji Savanier (Montpellier) is cleared to safety by the defence.
25' Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) receives a pass and fires a shot in from long range, but it's blocked.
23' The game is interrupted now, Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) picks up a knock and the physio has to come on.
19' Jordan Ferri (Montpellier) produces an effort from the edge of the box, but doesn't hit the ball properly and sends it yards wide of the right post.
18' Metz hold the ball and display nice passing from player to player.
17' The assistant referee raises his flag and the referee blows his whistle. Didier Lamkel Ze (Metz) puts the ball into the net, but he is flagged for offside.
15' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) picks up a rebound inside the penalty area and sends a shot to the left side of the goal, but is denied by a reflex save from Alexandre Oukidja.
13' The free kick from close range, taken by Metz, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
13' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Kiki Kouyate (Montpellier) was quite harsh and Jeremy Stinat didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
12' Georges Mikautadze (Metz) breaks into the penalty area but his shot is blocked.
12' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear.
10' Mousa Al-Tamari (Montpellier) receives the ball inside the box from the resulting free kick, but fails to score as his shot is blocked by one of the defenders.
9' Teji Savanier (Montpellier) floats the free kick into the box, but it's easily cleared by the first man.
6' Silvan Hefti (Montpellier) should know this behaviour is beyond the rules. He was too careless with his challenge and left Jeremy Stinat no option but to blow his whistle.
3' 1 - 0 Goal! Issiaga Sylla (Montpellier) receives a well-taken defence-splitting pass inside the box and fires the ball past the goalkeeper.
1' The ball goes out for a corner. Montpellier can continue in their attacking effort.
1' The referee blows his whistle and we are underway.
Montpellier will kick the game off.
Jeremy Stinat is introduced as the referee for today's match.
Show lineups The starting lineups for this match have been revealed.
